verses.html: 18 Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:
verses.text: 18 Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:

verses.html: 19 “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
verses.text: 19 “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.

verses.html: 20 Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
verses.text: 20 Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.

verses.html: 21 Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
verses.text: 21 Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.

verses.html: 22 In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
verses.text: 22 In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.

verses.html: 23 In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
verses.text: 23 In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”

verses.html: 24 Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
verses.text: 24 Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?

verses.html: 25 When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
verses.text: 25 When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.

verses.html: 26 But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.text: 26 But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

verses.html: 27 He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
verses.text: 27 He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”

verses.html: 18 And Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, come to him and were questioning him, saying,
verses.text: 18 And Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, come to him and were questioning him, saying,

verses.html: 19 “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if someone’s brother dies and leaves behind a wife but does not leave a child, his brother should take the wife and raise up seed for his brother.
verses.text: 19 “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if someone’s brother dies and leaves behind a wife but does not leave a child, his brother should take the wife and raise up seed for his brother.

verses.html: 20 There were seven brothers, and the first took a wife and dying, did not leave seed,
verses.text: 20 There were seven brothers, and the first took a wife and dying, did not leave seed,

verses.html: 21 and the second took her and died, not having left seed, and the third likewise.
verses.text: 21 and the second took her and died, not having left seed, and the third likewise.

verses.html: 22 And the seven did not leave seed. Last of all, the woman also died.
verses.text: 22 And the seven did not leave seed. Last of all, the woman also died.

verses.html: 23 In the resurrection, when they rise again, of which of them will she be a wife? For the seven had her {as} wife.”
verses.text: 23 In the resurrection, when they rise again, of which of them will she be a wife? For the seven had her {as} wife.”

verses.html: 24 Jesus said to them, “Are you not being led astray because of this, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?
verses.text: 24 Jesus said to them, “Are you not being led astray because of this, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

verses.html: 25 For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but they are like angels in the heavens.
verses.text: 25 For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but they are like angels in the heavens.

verses.html: 26 But concerning the dead, that they are raised, did you not read in the book of Moses, at the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.text: 26 But concerning the dead, that they are raised, did you not read in the book of Moses, at the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

verses.html: 27 He is not a God of the dead, but of the living. You are being much deceived.”
verses.text: 27 He is not a God of the dead, but of the living. You are being much deceived.”

verses.html: 18 After that, some Sadducees approached Jesus. They are a Jewish group that does not believe that God will make people who have died alive again. They asked Jesus,
verses.text: 18 After that, some Sadducees approached Jesus. They are a Jewish group that does not believe that God will make people who have died alive again. They asked Jesus,

verses.html: 19 “Instructor, Moses wrote for us {in the Scriptures} about what should happen when a man with a wife, but no children, dies. When that happens, the dead man’s brother should marry the {dead man’s} wife. When they have a child, they should consider it to be the child of the dead man.
verses.text: 19 “Instructor, Moses wrote for us {in the Scriptures} about what should happen when a man with a wife, but no children, dies. When that happens, the dead man’s brother should marry the {dead man’s} wife. When they have a child, they should consider it to be the child of the dead man.

verses.html: 20 {So, consider this situation}: there were seven brothers. One brother married a woman, but then he died before he had children.
verses.text: 20 {So, consider this situation}: there were seven brothers. One brother married a woman, but then he died before he had children.

verses.html: 21 Then, the second brother {obeyed this law and} married the woman. However, he too died before he had children. The same thing happened to the third brother.
verses.text: 21 Then, the second brother {obeyed this law and} married the woman. However, he too died before he had children. The same thing happened to the third brother.

verses.html: 22 In this way, each of the seven brothers {married the woman but} died before they had children. Finally, the woman died too.
verses.text: 22 In this way, each of the seven brothers {married the woman but} died before they had children. Finally, the woman died too.

verses.html: 23 So, of those brothers, whose wife will she be when God makes people alive again? {We ask} because she got married to all seven brothers {at different times}.”
verses.text: 23 So, of those brothers, whose wife will she be when God makes people alive again? {We ask} because she got married to all seven brothers {at different times}.”

verses.html: 24 Jesus replied, “You do not realize what the Scriptures mean or how powerful God is. Because of that, you believe what is wrong!
verses.text: 24 Jesus replied, “You do not realize what the Scriptures mean or how powerful God is. Because of that, you believe what is wrong!

verses.html: 25 Here is what I mean: when God makes people alive again, they will not get married. Instead, they will be like angels who dwell in heaven {and do not get married}.
verses.text: 25 Here is what I mean: when God makes people alive again, they will not get married. Instead, they will be like angels who dwell in heaven {and do not get married}.

verses.html: 26 Now I will speak about whether God makes people who have died alive again. You have read in the section of the Scriptures that Moses wrote the story about {how God appeared to Moses in a} bush. In that story, God told Moses, ‘I am the God whom Abraham worships, the God whom Isaac worships, and the God whom Jacob worships.’
verses.text: 26 Now I will speak about whether God makes people who have died alive again. You have read in the section of the Scriptures that Moses wrote the story about {how God appeared to Moses in a} bush. In that story, God told Moses, ‘I am the God whom Abraham worships, the God whom Isaac worships, and the God whom Jacob worships.’

verses.html: 27 It is living people who worship God, not dead people. {So, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who all have died, must become alive again!} So, you have believed many things that are wrong.”
verses.text: 27 It is living people who worship God, not dead people. {So, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who all have died, must become alive again!} So, you have believed many things that are wrong.”
